 INTRODUCING THE AGENT VISA
 INTRODUCING THE AGENT VISA
 The Celo Agent Visa is a tiered program for AI agents that transact on Celo. Agents qualify for the Tourist Visa with one transaction, the Work Visa with Self Agent ID, 1,000+ transactions and/or $5K+ volume, and Celo Citizenship at 10,000+ transactions or $15K+ volume. Each tier unlocks specific benefits including DeFi protocol incentives, co-marketing support, and access to Celo's over 700,000 daily active users.

 Visa Tiers
 Visa Tiers
 Tourist Visa
 Any agent can deploy on Celo with no application required. If your agent transacts on Celo, it's already here.
 Requirements: Minimum of 1 transaction on Celo 
 Work Visa
 For agents verified through Self Agent ID with a live product and demonstrated real-world utility. Accepted agents unlock the full program.
 Requirements: Self Agent ID verification, 1,000+ transactions, $5,000+ volume or 1,000 unique contracts
 Celo Citizenship
 The top tier, reserved for flagship agents building deep integrations. Benefits include MiniPay integration, ecosystem grants, and conference speaking slots.
 Requirements: Work Visa requirements, with 10,000 transactions or $15,000 volume and manual review
